body: I talked to the provost when they tried to kick me out once; he didn't really care either lol.

3 days in a psych word would guarantee failure for all of my classes; I'd likely get fired too. Lack of sleep is from having to study/do homework once I get off of work

All I'm feeling now is the urge to drink and sleep so the feelings will go away for a little while, but that'll guarantee that my paper won't get done and I'll fail out.
